title: ONLY GOD CAN LIFT YOU
text: Something is happening in this place right now. I want you to feel it. Do not dismiss what your spirit is sensing. There is a weight in this atmosphere. It is not ordinary. Heaven is bending over this moment, and I want you to receive with open hands what the Lord is releasing tonight. Before I say anything else, I need somebody to just lift your hands where you are and say, "Lord, I receive." Say it like you mean it. "Lord, I receive." Because what is about to happen in this room is not a lecture, it is not a seminar, this is an encounter, and encounters change men permanently. Father, we honor you. We acknowledge that you are the reason we are gathered. Every intelligence that came here tonight with another agenda, I silence you now by the blood of Jesus. Every distraction, every veil, every spiritual blindness, Lord, let your fire burn it down right now. Open eyes, open ears. Let the soil of every heart become fertile ground for the word of the Lord this night in the name of Jesus. Now, hear me. There is something that God wants to do in your life that no man can do. Let me say that again. There is something God has scheduled for your life that no connection, no background, no certificate, no strategy, no human cleverness can manufacture. And tonight, the spirit of the living God sent me to announce it to you. The title that came to my spirit is this, "Only God can lift you." Psalm 75 verses 6 and 7. I want you to write it down, read it slowly when you get home. It says, "For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south, but God is the judge. He putteth down one and setteth up another." I need somebody to shout hallelujah in this place because this scripture just dismantled every anxiety you walked in here with tonight. Promotion does not come from the east. That means your boss cannot stop what God has scheduled for you. Your enemy cannot stop what God has ordained. The system cannot stop it. The economy cannot stop it. Promotion does not come from the east, it does not come from the west, it does not come from the south, but God is the judge. He putted down one and he setted up another. This means somewhere tonight God is making a decision about your life. Right now, this very moment. While you are seated in this chair, while your enemies are celebrating, while the wicked are reporting you before their shrines, God is making a decision and his decision is final. I want to teach you something quickly before we go into the fire tonight. There are two categories of people in the earth. The first category are people who have learned the art of self-promotion. They know how to network, they know who to call. They know which dinner table to sit at, they understand political navigation and nothing is wrong with wisdom. I'm not against wisdom. But here is the danger. When a man trusts in his own lifting, he builds on sand. When a man's elevation is manufactured by human strategy alone, the same humans who lifted him can bring him down. But the second category, these are the men and women who have discovered that there is a lifter and when God lifts a man, no devil in hell, no conspiracy in the earth, no committee of darkness, no gathering of the wicked can put that man down. Psalm 3:3, David said, "But thou, oh Lord, art a shield for me, my glory and the lifter up of mine head." Did you hear that? My glory and the lifter up of my head. David was in the middle of one of the most devastating seasons of his life when he wrote that. His own son, Absalom, had stolen his kingdom. His closest friends had betrayed him, his advisors had turned, his city had rejected him, he was fleeing, the king was running, and yet in the middle of that David opened his mouth and declared, "But thou, oh Lord, art the lifter up of my head." There is a butt in your situation tonight. You have seen the facts, you have read the medical report, you have received the rejection letter, you have counted the losses, you have calculated how impossible your recovery looks. But but there is a God in heaven who is the lifter. And I decree by the spirit of the living God every head that has been bowed down in shame, every destiny that has been suppressed, every glory that has been buried tonight, the lifter is here. Now, let me go deeper. Why is it that only God can lift you? Why is it that human effort, no matter how intense, can never fully accomplish what God's sovereign hand can do in a moment? Isaiah 40 verses 15 and 17. Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance. Behold, he taketh up the aisles as a very little thing. All nations before him are as nothing, and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity. If the nations of the earth, all the superpowers, all the governments, all the financial systems of the world are as a drop in a bucket before God, what does that make your problem? What does that make the enemy fighting you? What does that make the people who said you will never rise? They are less than a drop, they are counted as nothing, and vanity. God does not need a committee to lift you. He does not need to consult the economy, he does not need permission from the system. He speaks and it is done. He decrees and things align. He breathes on a situation, and suddenly there is a turn around that defies human explanation. I want to tell you something about the nature of divine lifting. When God lifts a man, it is sudden. Genesis 41. Joseph was in prison. He had been in that prison not for weeks, not for months. He had been there for years. And in one morning, one morning he went from the prison to the palace, not gradually, suddenly. In one day, his address changed, his clothing changed, his reign changed, his title changed, his influence changed, not because he campaigned, not because he lobbied, but because the hand of God moved. There is somebody here tonight and your lifting is coming suddenly, not slowly, suddenly. God is about to do something in your life that will shock even the people who know you. It will shock you. You will look in the mirror and say, "Is this me? Is this my life?" And the answer will be yes because God did it. 1 Samuel 2:8. Hannah prophesied and said, "He raiseth up the poor out of the dust and lifted up the beggar from the dunghill to set them among princes and to make them inherit the throne of glory." From the dunghill to the throne, from the dust to the palace, from begging to inheritance. This is the testimony God wants to write about your life. Now, hear me carefully. Lifting in the kingdom has protocols. There are things that position a man for divine elevation. You cannot just claim the promise without understanding the principles. Let me give you three quickly. The first is you must know who your lifter is. You must have a genuine, personal, experiential knowledge of God, not just theological knowledge, not just church attendance. I am talking about the kind of knowing that Job spoke about. I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear, but now mine eyes see at thee. Job 42:5. When you know God intimately, you have access to a lifting that bypasses every earthly system. The second [music] protocol is you must refuse to lift yourself prematurely. Proverbs 25:6 says, "Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king, and stand not in the place of great men." One of the greatest temptations on the path to destiny is a temptation to rush your own elevation, to take shortcuts, to manufacture what God said he would give freely. And when men try to lift themselves before the appointed time, they rise in the flesh and fall in the spirit. But when you wait, when you humble yourself under the mighty hand of God, 1 Peter 5:6 says he shall exalt you in due time. The third is you must engage the prayer altar. Daniel purposed in his heart. He prayed [music] three times a day. He opened his windows towards Jerusalem. And the result? >> [music] >> Daniel 6:3. "Then this Daniel was preferred above the presidents and princes because an excellent spirit was in him, and the king thought to set him over the whole realm." Prayer is not begging. Prayer is the mechanism by which you engage the government of heaven. And when heaven's government moves on your behalf, no earthly government can resist it. Now, I want to shift into warfare because something is happening in this atmosphere. I see chains. I see chains on hands. I see chains on destinies. I see invisible cages around people in this room, people whose potential has been locked. People who have been trying to fly, but something keeps pulling them back. Something in the spirit has been working against their advancement. Every time they are about to break through, something happens. Every time they are about to rise, something pulls them down. And the The said to me, "Tonight is the night of breaking." I come against every spiritual chain in this place in the name of Jesus. Every generational anchor that has been holding families in one place for generations, this is your breaking point. The cycle stops tonight. >> [music] >> The pattern of stagnation breaks tonight. The spirit of limitation loses its grip tonight. I decree over every person under the sound of my voice, your hands are free, your feet are free, your mind is free, your destiny is free, the cage is open, and you are coming out now in the name of Jesus. Let us pray. Father, I stand before you on behalf of every soul present tonight. Lord, you said in your word in Jeremiah 29:11 that your thoughts toward us are thoughts of peace and not of evil to give us an expected end. Lord, that expected end, let it manifest. Let it manifest now. Let the plans you wrote in eternity begin to materialize in time. In the name of Jesus, >> [music] >> I decree every enemy of divine timing in your life, I silence you now. Every demon assigned to delay your destiny, your assignment ends tonight. I bind you, I restrain you, I remove your hands from the life of every person in this room in the name of Jesus. Father, the way you move for Joseph, move now. The way you move for Esther, move now. The way you move for Ruth, move now. The way you move for David, move now. For these are your people. These are the people of your pasture, and you are their shepherd and their lifter. I pray [music] for divine acceleration. Lord, let the years the enemy stole, restore them now. Let the opportunities that were hijacked, restore them now. Let the connections that were broken by demonic manipulation restore them now in the name of Jesus. I speak to every closed door in your life, open in the name of Jesus, open. The command of heaven is upon you tonight, open. Every door of opportunity that has been shut by witchcraft open. Every door of promotion that has been sealed by evil covenants open. Every door of financial breakthrough that has been locked by ancestral causes open in Jesus' name. Hear me, I am breaking every cause of limitation over your life tonight. Every word spoken by a parent in anger that became a cause, I cancel it by the blood of Jesus. Every pronouncement made at the evil altar against your rising, I nullify it by the blood of Jesus. Every vow made by your enemies that you will not prosper, I reverse it by the blood of Jesus. You will prosper, you will rise, you will be seen, you will be celebrated, you will be honored not because of your strength, but because God is your lifter. I speak to your finances now in the name of Jesus. Poverty, your grip is broken. Debt, your cycle is broken. Financial stagnation, your hold is broken. I declare open heavens over your finances. I declare new streams of income opening up. I declare supernatural debt cancellation. I declare unexpected financial turnarounds. I declare that the blessings of Abraham, which the word says come upon us through Christ Jesus in Galatians 3:14, those blessings are yours. They are activated, they are released over you now in the name of Jesus. Every financial witchcraft working against your income, eating your money before it reaches your hands, causing leakage in your finances, I destroy you now. I scatter your operations. I dismantle your structures. I command every swallowed wealth to be released now in the name of Jesus. I hear the spirit saying there is somebody here who has been working, but nothing seems to show for it. You work and work and work, and at the end of the month you cannot explain where the money went. There is a devourer assigned against your finances. Malachi 3:11, God said, "I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes." I stand on that word tonight. I rebuke the devourer. I rebuke the spirit of consumption. I rebuke the spirit of financial wastage. I command your finances to be whole. I command your finances to multiply. I command your savings to grow. I command wealth to locate you in the name of Jesus. Now, I want to pray about health. There is somebody here with a body that has been under attack. There are symptoms that doctors have named and some they have not been able to name. There are pains that come and go. There are weakness and heaviness in your body that have become your daily companion, and the Lord said not so. Isaiah 53:5, "But he was wounded for our transgressions. He was bruised for our iniquities. The chastisement of our peace was upon him, and with his stripes we are healed." Notice, it is past tense, not we shall be healed. We are healed. The work is already done. The payment has been made. The blood of Jesus already purchased your total healing, and tonight I am enforcing that purchase. I come against every spirit of infirmity in this atmosphere. Every disease that entered through a spiritual door, I close the door and I cast you out. Every sickness rooted in generational patterns, I pull it up from the roots. Every attack against the organs of the body, lungs, liver, kidney, heart, womb, brain, I command healing now in the name of Jesus. I decree the same spirit that raised Christ from the dead, which dwells in you according to Romans 8:11, is quickening your mortal body right now. Life is flowing into dead cells. Life is flowing into sick tissues. Life is flowing into broken bones. Tumors are dissolving. Infections are dying. Inflammation is ceasing in the name of Jesus. To the person who has been told they cannot have children, God is the opener of the womb. Genesis 20:17. He opened the womb of Sarah. He opened the womb of Hannah. He opened the womb of Rachel. And I decree by the spirit of God, that womb is open tonight. That womb is healed. That womb is productive in Jesus' name. I decree conception. I decree full-term pregnancy. I decree the sound of children in your home in the name of Jesus. To the person whose body has been under sustained demonic attack, I decree total recovery. I decree every organ is restored to factory settings. I decree divine health. I decree the life of God overwhelming every sickness in Jesus' name. Now, let me go into family and marriage. There are families that have been under coordinated satanic attack for too long. Families where marriages keep breaking. Families where children keep going astray. Families where one person rises and something happens to bring them down. Generational patterns, familiar spirits assigned to bloodlines. Hear me, I have authority in this name. I break every generational curse operating in your bloodline tonight. Every covenant your ancestors made with darkness that is still demanding legal right over your family. I cancel it by the blood of Jesus. Every familiar spirit assigned to your lineage, I cut the assignment. I remove you from this family. In the name of Jesus, I decree peace in your home. I decree restoration of broken marriages. Every marriage that the enemy has been targeting, I surround it with the fire of the Holy Ghost. I release divine love between spouses. I release forgiveness. I release understanding. I release the grace to make a marriage work even when it is hard, in the name of Jesus. To the person whose spouse has strayed, I decree restoration. God can bring them back. He brought the prodigal son back. He can bring your marriage back. I decree a divine reversal. I decree that every spirit of lust and infidelity assigned against your home is cast out now, in the name of Jesus. To the person believing God for a life partner, I decree divine connection. Your ordained partner is being prepared and positioned. I decree divine timing. I decree no more delay. No more wrong connections. No more counterfeit relationships. I decree alignment with God's original design for your life. In the name of Jesus. I come against every spirit of strife, every spirit of division, every spirit of suspicion in marriages and families. I command peace. I command wholeness. I command unity. As Psalm 133 verse 1 says, "Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity." That atmosphere of unity, I release it over your home now. Children who have gone astray, I decree their return. The spirit of waywardness, the spirit of rebellion, the spirit of addiction, I cast you out of the lives of the children in this room. >> [music] >> I decree that prodigal children are coming home. I decree that they will return. I decree a divine awakening in the hearts of every child who has wandered from the path of God in the name of Jesus. Let me pray about destiny right now. There are people in this room whose destiny has been tampered with dreams that were buried, visions that were stolen, purposes that were aborted before they could manifest. The enemy saw what was in your future and he worked hard to make sure it never happened. But hear me, the thief cannot keep what he stole. John 10:10, the thief cometh not but for to steal and to kill and to destroy. I am come that they might have life and that they might have it more abundantly. Jesus came that you might have life, abundant life, not struggling life, not barely surviving life, abundant, overflowing, exceeding. And I decree tonight your stolen destiny is being returned to you. I speak to every buried gift in this room, come alive. Every suppressed talent, arise. Every dormant calling, activate. Every delayed dream, be resurrected. In the name of Jesus. I speak to young people in this room whose parents could not afford to develop their gifts. God is about to make provision that will accelerate your development supernaturally. You will not be limited by what your background could not give you. God is your father and he is rich. He owns the cattle on a thousand hills. Psalm 50:10. And he is about to fund your destiny in ways that will astonish the people around you. I speak to entrepreneurs and business people, ideas that have been blocked are being released tonight. Innovations that heaven deposited in you are coming to the surface. Divine strategies are being downloaded right now. Business connections that money cannot buy are being arranged by angels in the name of Jesus. I speak to ministers and men and women of God in this room. The anointing upon your life is increasing right now. Every spiritual blockage in your ministry is being dismantled. Every demonic gate erected against the expansion of your vision is being torn down. Your ministry will grow. Your voice will be heard. Your message will reach the nations in the name of Jesus. Now, I want to go into warfare prayer. I want to deal with things in the spirit. Close your eyes. Lift your hands. Agree with me. Father, in the name of Jesus, I take authority over the second heaven over the lives of every person present. I pull down every stronghold that has been erected against their progress. 2 Corinthians 10:4, "The weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds." I'm pulling them down now. Every principality, every power, every ruler of the darkness of this world, every spiritual wickedness in high places, Ephesians 6:12, I confront you with the name of Jesus. I confront you with the blood of Jesus. I confront you with the fire of the Holy Ghost. You have no right over the children of God. You have no legal access to their lives, their minds, their families, their finances, their health. Every legal ground you've been standing on, the blood of Jesus has removed it. In Jesus name, I speak to witchcraft operations working against people in this room. Every coven meeting that has been called concerning the lives of these people, I scatter the meeting now. I release confusion in the camp of the enemy. I release fire. I release divine disruption. In Jesus name, every evil altar raised against someone in this room, I pull it down now. I scatter the materials. I break the evil priest power. I command every sacrifice that was made to be consumed by fire and rendered powerless in the name of Jesus. Every curse dispatched from an evil altar, I cancel it by the blood of Jesus. It shall not land. It shall not prosper. It shall not find a resting place. Isaiah 54:17, "No weapon formed against you shall prosper. Every tongue that has risen against you in judgment shall be condemned." This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord. I speak to marine spirits working against marriages, against financial progress, against people's minds. I bind you in the name of Jesus. I cut every soul tie between these people and water spirits. I command you out of their dreams, out of their marriages, out of their finances, out of their emotions. You have no place in their lives. Come out now in Jesus' name. I speak to the spirit of python, that spirit of constriction that squeezes people's breathing space, that spirit that makes people feel they cannot breathe financially, emotionally, spiritually. I bind you in the name of Jesus. I release freedom. I release wide open spaces. I decree enlargement over every life in this room. Psalm 4:1, "Thou has enlarged me when I was in distress." I break the spirit of premature death over this room. No one here would die before their time. No accident. No sudden termination. No premature ending. I decree long life. Psalm 91:16, "With long life will I satisfy him and show him my salvation." That covenant is yours tonight. You will live. You will not die. And you will declare the works of the Lord. Psalm 118:17. I speak to every terminal diagnosis over lives in this room. By the stripes of Jesus, I cancel you. You are not final. You are not the last word. God has the last word. And his word says by his stripes you are healed. I receive that. I release it. It is done in the name of Jesus. Now, I want to pray about open heavens. Malachi 3:10, God said, "Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, said the Lord of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven and pour you out a blessing that there shall not be room enough to receive it." I decree open heavens over every faithful giver in this room. Every seed sown in faith, I decree divine multiplication. Every sacrifice made in obedience, I decree supernatural return. The windows of heaven are open over your life tonight. Blessings are raining, overflow is raining, favor is raining, connections are raining, health is raining, wisdom is raining. All that you need is coming down upon you right now in the name of Jesus. I speak to the angel that God has assigned to your life be activated now. Go ahead of them, prepare the way before them, smooth out every rough path, straighten every crooked road, open every closed door, release every withheld blessing in the name of Jesus. Hebrews 1:14 says angels are ministering spirits sent to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation. Your angel has an assignment. >> [music] >> Tonight, I release the angels into active duty over your life. Go, work, move, prepare, fight in the name of Jesus. I see a prophetic picture right now. I see hands, hands reaching down from above, and those hands are lifting lifting someone out of a pit, lifting someone out of a place they should not have been. Lifting someone out of a situation that seemed like there was no exit, and I hear the Lord saying, "I have not forgotten you. I have not abandoned you. I have been watching and waiting for the right moment, and this is the moment. This is your moment. Not next year, not when the economy improves, not when people change, not when circumstances align. Now, this is the moment the Lord has chosen for your lifting, and when God decides to lift, nothing can stop it. I decree your lifting is now, your rising is now, your recovery is now, your restoration is now, your overflow is now, in the name of Jesus. Somebody shout amen in this place. Let me pray for those who have been waiting. People who have prayed for years, people who have believed for things that have not yet manifested. People who are tired, people who are on the verge of giving up. People who have lost their capacity to dream because hope deferred has made their heart sick. Proverbs 13:12, I pray for you specifically right now. Father, for every tired heart in this room, renew their strength. Isaiah 40:31, but they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength. They shall mount up with wings as eagles. They shall run and not be weary, and they shall walk and not faint. Lord, let that strength come now. Let the weariness lift. Let the discouragement break. Let hope come alive again in their hearts, in Jesus' name. I decree your waiting is not wasted. God does not waste pain. God does not waste processes. Everything you have been through has been forming something in you. The waiting has been preparing you for the weight of what God is about to give you. And the glory that is coming is worth everything you went through to get there. In the name of Jesus, I break the spirit of despair. I break the spirit of hopelessness. I break the spirit of depression. I command every cloud of darkness over your mind and emotions to lift now. I command light to shine in the darkest places of your soul. I command joy, the joy of the Lord, which is your strength, to flood your being right now. In the name of Jesus. Hear me. God has not moved. God has not changed his mind about you. Numbers 23:19 says, "God is not a man that he should lie, neither the son of man that he should repent. Hath he said, and shall he not do it? Or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?" Whatever he said he would do, he will do it. Whatever he promised, he will fulfill it. Whatever he showed you in the night season, it shall come to pass. You have not misheard God. You have not been deceived. The vision is real. The promise is real. And the God who gave you the promise is real. He will bring it to pass. I decree fulfillment over your life. I decree that every promise of God concerning you will be yes and amen. 2 Corinthians 1:20. Every vision will be fulfilled. Every dream will be realized. Every word the Lord has spoken over your life will come to pass. In the name of Jesus. Now, this is important. I feel the spirit shifting into something. There are evil covenants, some entered knowingly, some unknowingly. There are people who at some point in their lives, in moments of desperation or in ignorance, agreed with darkness. Covenants made in secret. Initiations that happened. Vows taken that were never broken. Agreements made on your behalf by family members without your knowledge, these things have been creating invisible ceilings over your life. Every time you try to rise above a certain level, you hit something. You cannot explain it. People around you have gone ahead but you keep being held at the same level. It is a covenant ceiling. Tonight, I break every evil covenant over your life. I break it by the power of the blood of Jesus. The blood of Jesus speaks better things than the blood of evil covenants. Hebrews 12:24. The blood of Jesus is more powerful than every covenant made in darkness. And by that blood, I announce freedom over you tonight. Every covenant with the spirit of the land broken. Every blood covenant made at shrines broken. Every sex covenant that created soul ties broken. Every covenant inherited through family initiations broken. Every demonic agreement, written or oral, known or unknown, broken and destroyed by the blood of Jesus. In Jesus' name, you are free. Let me say it again, you are free. The chains are off. The ceiling is gone. The covenant is canceled. You are free to rise. You are free to fly. You are free to be everything God created you to be. I hear the Lord saying something. He says, "Tell my people that I am not limited by their past. Tell them that I am not limited by their failures. Tell them that I am not bound by the mistakes they made. Tell them that my mercies are new every morning." Lamentations 3:23. And this morning, this season, this moment is a new beginning. No matter what happened before tonight, tonight is a reset. It is a restart. It is a divine repositioning. God is taking you from where you were and putting you where you were supposed to be. And it shall happen quickly. It shall happen suddenly. It shall happen in ways that will make people ask what happened to this person and your answer will be God happened to me. God lifted me. God showed up and everything changed. I speak to every impossible situation before you tonight. I speak the word of the Lord. Nothing is too hard for God. Jeremiah 32:27, "Behold, I am the Lord, the God of all flesh. Is there anything too hard for me?" >> [music] >> Not your situation, not your case, not your diagnosis, not your deficit, not your history, not your failure, nothing is too hard for God. And what is impossible with men is possible with God. Luke 18:27, God is stepping into your impossibility tonight. He's taking what was declared impossible and making it possible. He's taking what was called dead and calling it back to life. He's taking what the enemy called finished and announcing a new beginning. I come against the spirit of impossibility over your life. I break the stronghold of impossibility. I replace it with the spirit of possibility. I replace it with faith. I replace it with the limitless nature of God in the name of Jesus. I want to close with this. The Bible says in Psalm 121:1-2, "I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the Lord which made heaven and earth." Your help is not coming from the hills. Your help is coming from the one who made the hills. Your help is not coming from the government. Your help is coming from the one who established governments. Your help is not coming from a man. Your help is coming from the Lord. And the Lord who made heaven and earth, the Lord who spoke galaxies into existence, the Lord who holds the oceans in the hollow of his hand, that Lord is your helper tonight. He shall not suffer your foot to be moved. He that keepeth you shall not slumber. He that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep. Psalm 121 verses 3 and 4. God is awake over your situation. He's not sleeping. He's not distracted. He's watching. He's working. And at the exact moment he has chosen, he will move. And when he moves, everything moves with him. Mountains move, seas part, prison doors open, lions' mouths close, fiery furnaces cool down, dead things live again. Dry bones stand up and become an army. This is your God. And this is your moment. Father, I release every blessing, every breakthrough, every miracle, every turnaround, every healing, every restoration over every person under the sound of my voice tonight. Let it be done. Let it manifest. Let it be real tangibly, measurably, undeniably real in their lives in Jesus' mighty and matchless name. Somebody give God a shout of praise in this place. Not a small praise, a violent praise. A praise that shakes the atmosphere. A praise that silences the enemy. A praise that says I believe. I believe what God said. I believe it before I see it. I believe it right now. And I am going to praise my way into the manifestation of every promise. Shout. Shout now. Let the roof come off this place with your praise. Heaven is responding. Angels are moving. The answer is on its way. Your lifting has begun. To every person watching or listening, this is not the end of your story. The enemy lied to you when he told you it was over. The best chapters of your life are ahead of you. God has reserved the best for this season. And the lifter of your head, the Lord God Almighty has already made a decision about your life. He will lift you. He has already decided and no power in heaven, in earth, or under the earth can reverse what God has decided. Receive it, walk in it, live in it, and give God all the glory. In the name of Jesus, it is done. Amen.
